name: Provinces and Regions of China
description: 33 divisions. Four exercises: name the highlighted province or region, locate it, recall a capital, and name the province or region from its capital. City divisions omit redundant capital faces; ambiguous shared-capital reverse cards are omitted. Covers 31 mainland divisions plus Hong Kong and Macau. Taiwan is studied separately in Countries of the World. Includes the Regional map and capitals card type. Borders and multilingual names from Natural Earth; capital sources are credited on each item.
author: Joao Henrique Costa Araujo

const dist = (a,b,max) => {
  if (Math.abs(a.length-b.length)>max) return max+1;
  let p2=null,p=Array.from({length:b.length+1},(_,j)=>j);
  for(let i=1;i<=a.length;i++) {
    const row=[i];let low=i;
    for(let j=1;j<=b.length;j++) {
      let n=Math.min(p[j]+1,row[j-1]+1,p[j-1]+(a[i-1]===b[j-1]?0:1));
      if(p2&&i>1&&j>1&&a[i-1]===b[j-2]&&a[i-2]===b[j-1])n=Math.min(n,p2[j-2]+1);
      row.push(n);low=Math.min(low,n);
    }
    if(low>max)return max+1;p2=p;p=row;
  }
  return p[b.length];
};

if(!said)return {score:0,feedback:"No answer."};
if(values.includes(said))return {score:1};
for(let i=0;i<units.length;i++) {
  if(i===key.index)continue;
  const other=(isCapital?units[i].capitals:units[i].aliases).map(norm);
  if(other.includes(said))return {score:0,feedback:isCapital?`That is a capital of ${units[i].state}. ${key.state}: ${key.capital}.`:`That is ${units[i].state}. This is ${key.state}.`,details:{otherIndex:i,otherName:units[i].state}};
}

if(max) {

    for(let i=0;i<units.length;i++)if(i!==key.index)for(const v of (isCapital?units[i].capitals:units[i].aliases))otherBest=Math.min(otherBest,dist(said,norm(v),best));
